units.source_text: 却说六条妃子此次懊恼之深，为近年来所无。

en.t: Now Lady Rokujo's anguish on this occasion was deeper than anything she had felt in recent years.

units.source_text: 她怨恨源氏公子无情，对他已经断念。

en.t: She resented Prince Genji for his heartlessness and had already given up on him.

units.source_text: 但倘和他绝交，毅然赴伊势蛰居，则又未免无聊，况且被天下人取笑。

en.t: Yet if she broke with him and resolutely went off to Ise to live in seclusion, it would inevitably be dreary, and besides, people everywhere would laugh at her.

units.source_text: 反之，想留在京城，则如此残酷地受人侮辱，实属难堪。

en.t: On the other hand, if she tried to remain in the capital, it was truly unbearable to be so cruelly humiliated by others.

units.source_text: 正如古歌所云：“心如钓者之浮标，动荡不定逐海潮。”[\[9\]](#part1338.html#m9)

en.t: It was just as the old poem says: "My heart is like a fisherman's float, tossed unsteadily along by the sea tide."[\[9\]](#part1338.html#m9)
In her heart, she wavered and could not decide.

units.source_text: 想是日夜忧恼之故，她的心仿佛摆脱了身体而浮游在空中，痛苦不堪。

en.t: Perhaps because she worried day and night, her spirit seemed to have slipped free of her body and was floating in the air, leaving her in unbearable pain.
